description: Presenting our 2016 BMW M4 GTS, finished in Alpine White over a Black Leather and Alcantara interior with signature Acid Orange accents. Showing just 9,700 miles, this is an exceptionally preserved example of one of BMW M s most exclusive and uncompromising modern performance cars. Built as a street-legal track weapon, the M4 GTS took the standard M4 formula to an entirely different level. BMW limited production to approximately 700 examples worldwide, making the GTS one of the rarest modern M cars. Its 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged inline-six produces 493 horsepower and 442 lb-ft of torque, with BMW s innovative water-injection system helping deliver the additional performance. Power is sent through a 7-speed M DCT transmission to the rear wheels. The GTS was engineered around performance, weight reduction, and aerodynamics, featuring extensive carbon-fiber components, adjustable front and rear aero, M Carbon Ceramic Brakes, titanium exhaust, Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 tires, and GTS-specific suspension. Inside, the GTS is every bit as special, featuring factory carbon-fiber bucket seats, Alcantara steering wheel with Acid Orange center marker, lightweight door panels, and the factory Clubsport Package with an Acid Orange roll bar, six-point harnesses, and fire extinguisher. Highlights include: -9,700 Miles -493 HP / 442 LB-FT -BMW Water Injection System -7-Speed M DCT -Factory Clubsport Package -Acid Orange Roll Bar Harnesses -Carbon-Fiber Bucket Seats -M Carbon Ceramic Brakes -Carbon-Fiber Roof, Hood Aerodynamic Components -Adjustable Front Splitter Rear Wing -Titanium Exhaust -OLED Rear Taillights -Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 Tires The M4 GTS was BMW s answer to building an uncompromising, road-legal M car with genuine track-car capability. Contemporary comparisons even placed it against Porsche s 911 GT3 RS, and while BMW never officially marketed it as a direct competitor, the comparison speaks to the GTS s purpose and performance. With only 9,700 miles, this example presents exceptionally well and feels remarkably close to new. Rare, highly engineered, and increasingly collectible, the M4 GTS represents one of the most special modern cars to come from BMW M. Available now at Sports Car Collection. This 2021 GMC Sierra 1500 Denali is a capable pickup truck built to handle demanding work and deliver confidence on every drive.

- EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD with auto-locking rear differential

The cabin combines genuine wood accents with Forge perforated leather-appointed seating, creating an upscale environment. Climate control includes front dual-zone automatic temperature management and heated door mirrors, ensuring comfort in any season. The driver benefits from multiple memory settings, power windows with express features, and a heated steering wheel for added convenience.

This truck's capability matches its refinement. The trailering package provides everything needed for confident towing operations, while the adaptive ride control suspension adjusts to road conditions automatically. LED cargo area lighting illuminates the bed, and the power sliding rear window with rear defogger enhances functionality. Chrome recovery hooks stand ready when needed, and the 3.23 rear axle ratio delivers balanced performance and efficiency.

Safety technology is comprehensive throughout the vehicle. Forward pedestrian braking, rear cross traffic alert, lane change alert with side blind zone detection, and hill descent control work together to provide confidence in varied driving situations. The safety alert seat offers additional feedback during critical moments. Electronic stability control and traction control manage power delivery intelligently.

The GMC MultiPro Tailgate Step Lights, power sunroof, and 20-inch polished aluminum wheels enhance the truck's aggressive stance. Wireless charging, multiple USB ports including rear dual charging-only ports, and a 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot capable system keep occupants connected throughout the day.

This Sierra 1500 Denali combines the capability you need with the premium features you deserve. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and experience this truck firsthand.

description: Very Rare PMC Edition. Only 39,961 miles. Naturally aspirated V6. SH-AWD. Platinum White Pearl over Red Milano leather and Alcantara. This isn't simply another 2020 Acura TLX. This is the TLX PMC Edition, a special-production Acura created for buyers who wanted something considerably more exclusive. PMC stands for Performance Manufacturing Center, Acura's specialized facility in Marysville, Ohio best known as the home of the NSX. The TLX PMC Edition brought special attention to Acura's sport sedan, combining the naturally aspirated V6, Super Handling All-Wheel Drive, premium equipment, and exclusive PMC details into one distinctive package. The color combination immediately separates this example from an ordinary TLX. Platinum White Pearl contrasts beautifully with the Red interior, featuring premium perforated Milano leather and Alcantara inserts. Piano Black 19-inch alloy wheels complete the look, giving the car an aggressive edge without sacrificing Acura's understated luxury. And with only 39,961 miles, this example has traveled more than 25,000 fewer miles than market average. Under the hood is Acura's naturally aspirated 3.5-liter i-VTEC V6 producing 290 horsepower, paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission. No small turbocharged four-cylinder. Just the smooth response, sound, and character of a Honda-engineered naturally aspirated V6. Power goes through Acura's Super Handling All-Wheel Drive system, and SH-AWD does considerably more than provide traction in bad weather. Its torque-vectoring capability can actively distribute power between the rear wheels, helping the TLX rotate through corners and giving it a more responsive, confident personality. For Northwest drivers, that's genuine performance combined with excellent all-weather capability. Inside, this PMC Edition delivers the luxury to match its rarity. Heated and ventilated front sport seats, heated rear seats, a heated steering wheel, power moonroof, power front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, rain-sensing wipers, and premium Milano leather create a cabin that still feels special today. Acura Navigation with 3D View, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, AcuraLink, and the ELS Studio Premium Audio System provide the technology, while Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keeping Assist, automatic high beams, and additional driver-assistance systems add everyday confidence. EPA-estimated fuel economy is 20 MPG city and 29 MPG highway. But you don't seek out a PMC Edition because you're shopping for an ordinary luxury sedan. You buy it because it's something different. PMC provenance. Platinum White Pearl. Red Milano leather and Alcantara. Piano Black wheels. A naturally aspirated 290-horsepower V6. Torque-vectoring SH-AWD. And fewer than 40,000 miles. Offered by Honda of Kirkland, backed by more than 30 years of serving the greater Seattle and Kirkland communities. If you're searching for a special Acura, don't compare this only to ordinary TLXs. Low-mileage PMC Editions aren't something you'll see on every dealer's lot, and this Platinum White Pearl over Red example has the specification to match its rarity. Come see it at Honda of Kirkland, experience the V6 and SH-AWD for yourself, and see why the PMC Edition deserves to be viewed as something more than another used TLX.

Car runs and drives well. Great power and handling. I've owned since April, was fixing up but I was gifted another car and can't keep this as well.

This is a rare spec manual turbo with no modifications. The car was refurbished 2 months ago by VW mechanic with 20+ years experience- control arm bushings upgraded to Audi Tt poly bushings, timing belt service completed, water pump, thermostat, valve gasket cover, serpentine belt, oil pump, oil screen, oil pressure sensor, engine flush, oil change rod bearings inspected. I also replaced front driver and passenger door lock actuators. All OEM parts used. Seats are special bolstered models for Wolfsburg and have been professionally cleaned. The abs system has not worked since I bought and I have not diagnosed. Was going to do that eventually and told it would be about $350 to refurbish plus install. It brakes fine however so not totally necessary. The factory tint is good although slight crease on rear window.
The previous owner put smaller tires on the Long Beach rims, so miles are over reported by around 8 pct, since I'm not sure when... tires are in ok shape, one is getting close to needing replacing.

This 2012 Continental Flying Spur Speed is a striking example, finished in gorgeous Cardinal Red over a beautifully appointed Tan perforated leather interior with contrasting Red piping. The cabin is further elevated by an extensive Extended Leather treatment, including the roof and headliner, creating the rich, handcrafted atmosphere that has long defined the Bentley experience.  THE FLYING SPUR SPEED  The Continental Flying Spur represented Bentley's ability to combine the serenity of a grand touring automobile with the presence and capability of a true performance sedan. The Speed took that formula even further, pairing Bentley's legendary 6.0-liter twin-turbo W12 with 600 horsepower, 553 lb-ft of torque, all-wheel drive and a six-speed automatic transmission.  The result is extraordinary performance delivered in classic Bentley fashion immense speed with remarkable composure.  THE ALLURE OF BENTLEY  What makes this generation so compelling is its blend of old-world craftsmanship and modern engineering. Open the substantial doors and the atmosphere changes immediately. Rich leather, beautifully finished wood, polished metalwork and finely detailed controls surround the occupants. The seats are exceptionally comfortable, yet the Speed remains a genuine performance car.  This is an automobile designed to make even an ordinary drive feel like an occasion.  CARDINAL RED OVER TAN  The exterior color is one of this car's defining features. Cardinal Red gives the Flying Spur a deep, elegant presence, while the Tan interior creates a beautiful contrast. Red piping throughout the perforated leather adds another layer of individuality, while the Extended Leather treatmentincluding the roof/headlinermakes the cabin feel remarkably complete. The electric glass sunroof brings natural light into an interior already filled with the craftsmanship associated with Bentley. The Flying Spur Speed brought that philosophy into the modern era, creating a four-door Bentley capable of blending extraordinary comfort with serious performance.  That dual personality is what makes this car so compelling. It can quietly glide through town surrounded by leather and wood, then unleash a twelve-cylinder powertrain capable of turning an open road into an event.  WHY THIS FLYING SPUR?  This generation represents a fascinating chapter in Bentley history, bringing traditional craftsmanship into the modern performance era while retaining the character that made the marque famous. description:
The 2021 Ford Ranger XLT Tremor Off-Road Package greets drivers with a sense of control and confidence that's rare among crew cab trucks. Its steering is direct and well-weighted, delivering precise feedback on winding roads and stable assurance at highway speeds.

Enthusiasts who crave a truck that rewards attentive driving will find this Ranger's dynamics especially engaging. In daily commutes or spirited weekend drives around Sw Mt Vernon's rolling highways, its blend of responsiveness and comfort stands out. Dual Zone Climate Control ensures the cabin remains inviting for both driver and passengers, while the Ebony interior and Shadow Black Metallic exterior lend a purposeful, understated style. The locally owned provenance and non-smoker history appeal to those who care about vehicle stewardship as much as performance.

Performance is where the Ranger Tremor truly shines. The EcoBoost 2.3L I4 GTDi DOHC Turbocharged VCT engine delivers brisk throttle response, making merges and overtakes feel effortless without being abrupt. The 10-speed automatic transmission shifts with remarkable smoothness, responding quickly to both gentle and assertive inputs. Downshifts come predictably and with minimal delay, while manual mode lets drivers maintain control in challenging conditions. The off-road-tuned suspension with FOX dampers absorbs rough surfaces with composure, keeping the truck planted and minimizing body roll. The steering communicates road texture confidently, and the brake feel is progressive, offering strong stopping power and excellent pedal feedback. Terrain Management System and Trail Control provide selectable drive modes, allowing drivers to tailor the truck's behavior to changing surfaces and driving styles for a consistently rewarding experience.

Safety equipment in this truck complements driver involvement rather than detracting from it. Lane Keep Assist subtly guides the truck when lane departure is sensed, intervening only when necessary to support-not override-driver intent. Blind Spot Monitoring increases awareness during lane changes, while the Reverse Sensing System and Rear Camera provide clear visual and auditory cues for confident parking. Electronic Stability Control works quietly in the background, helping keep the truck poised without intruding on the direct, communicative feel at the wheel. Emergency communication via SYNC 3 911 Assist ensures a rapid connection should the unexpected occur, reinforcing confidence during both everyday driving and adventurous outings.

The Tremor Off-Road Package brings a focused set of features aimed at both utility and pleasure. FOX dampers, an off-road-tuned suspension, and the Terrain Management System elevate performance on and off pavement, while the Trail Control system offers cruise-like management over rugged terrain.

Compared to rivals like the Chevrolet Colorado ZR2 and Toyota Tacoma TRD Off-Road, the Ranger Tremor stands out for its refined balance between daily comfort and adventurous spirit.

Is the Ranger Tremor comfortable on long drives? The off-road-tuned suspension and Dual Zone Climate Control ensure fatigue-free cruising, blending firmness for control with enough compliance for comfort. How confident does it feel in corners and when merging? The FOX dampers and precise steering deliver stability and predictability, whether navigating freeway ramps or winding backroads.

To experience the driving engagement and everyday versatility of the Ranger XLT Tremor Off-Road Package, visit Lynch Ford Chevrolet at 410 Business 30 Sw Mt Vernon, IA 52314 or call . Take the next step toward rewarding time behind the wheel every day.
